subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: What product contract should OpenClaw use when assistant text repeats in a stream: abort-only, pause-and-confirm, retry/failover, session rollback, or a narrower combination?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but default strictness, false-positive tolerance, whether confirmation can safely resume suspect output, and how to sanitize session history are product and compatibility decisions automation should not invent.

options.title: Define A Core Stream Guard
options.body: Specify thresholds, alert copy, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup before implementing the detector in the embedded-agent stream path.

options.title: Defer To Timeout And Session Breaker Work
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for generation-timeout and broader session-health decisions before adding semantic stream detection.

options.title: Reject Resume Semantics
options.body: Allow a detector only to abort and quarantine the turn, avoiding a manual resume path that might continue looped output.

recommendation.title: Define A Core Stream Guard
recommendation.body: Specify thresholds, alert copy, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup before implementing the detector in the embedded-agent stream path.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest adjacent loop/config history and is the best available owner for the product contract choice.
